content.stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]关于欧盟反洗钱指令(AMLD)与成员国本地反洗钱法规的关系,以下哪两项表述准确？(选择两项.)

options.A: 欧盟反洗钱指令(AMLD)和地方反洗钱法规是相互独立且毫无关联的法律框架.
options.B: 欧盟反洗钱指令与当地反洗钱法规必须具有相同的要求.
options.C: 本地反洗钱法规可能会施加比欧盟《反洗钱指令》更严格或更多的要求.
options.D: 欧盟反洗钱指令无需成员国转化即可自动取代当地反洗钱法规.
options.E: 本地反洗钱法律法规优先于欧盟反洗钱指令的要求.

content.stem_en: Which two statements accurately describe the relationship between the EU AML Directives (AMLD) and local AML regulations in EU member states? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: The EU AMLD and local AML regulations are separate and unrelated legal frameworks.
options_en.B: The EU AMLD and local AML regulations must have identical requirements.
options_en.C: Local AML regulations may impose additional or more stringent requirements than the EU AMLD.
options_en.D: The EU AMLD automatically replaces local AML regulations without transposition by member states.
options_en.E: Local AML laws and regulations take precedence over the requirements of the EU AMLD.
